next.reason: §1985:VII.4.6.3 SR3 as amended by X3.23b-1993: 'The same file-name must not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement within the same Procedure Division.' The amendment replaced the 1985 print ('Appearance of file-name-1 in a USE statement must not cause the simultaneous request for execution of more than one USE procedure') with this textual test. §2023:14.9.49.3 SR8 states it word for word: 'The same file-name shall not appear in more than one USE AFTER EXCEPTION statement within the same procedure division.' The same sources are refused; the amended rule needs no general rule on declarative selection to carry it.
